args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but src/money.py was using ROUND_HALF_UP. This changes the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returns `2.66` as expected.

CI: passed (ci-0001)
